name: itaverax-demolisher-immunity
title: Itaverax Segmented Unit Immunity
author: TDSrock
description: Grants full itaverax damage resistance to all segmented-unit and segment prototypes, preventing demolishers (and other segmented enemies) from self-destructing due to Abacayba's itaverax melee damage bonus. This is a temporary stopgap until Abacayba itself ships a fix.
